desc.singulo.accelerator_controller: Controls a square ring 8–32 wide. Bigger rings are faster and yield more monopoles.
desc.singulo.accelerator_tube: Tube segment of the Particle Accelerator ring.
desc.singulo.archive_terminal: Copies ruin records onto data cards, restores degraded parts and decodes record fragments.
desc.singulo.artificial_star_core: A star core that replaces nether stars.
desc.singulo.basic_circuit: The brain of every early machine.
desc.singulo.basic_frame: The frame almost every machine is built on.
desc.singulo.blank_data_card: An empty card for copying records in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.builder_wand: Creative only. Instantly builds the multiblock of a controller. Sneak to change size.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity: Creates negative energy between mirrors to make exotic matter.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_controller: Goes on the side of the 5×5×5 cavity.
desc.singulo.catalytic_reactor: Makes catalysts, starting with the muon catalyst.
desc.singulo.ceramic_substrate: A fired ceramic board for circuits.
desc.singulo.cold_atoms: Atoms cooled close to absolute zero.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_1: Nine units of mass pressed together. The start of the compression chain.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2: Nine Lv1 blocks (eight if mixed). Fuel for the Degenerate Furnace.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2_mixed: Lv1 made from 3+ kinds of blocks needs only 8 for Lv2.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_1: A compressed block made only of metals.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_2: Denser metal block, used for artificial star cores.
desc.singulo.compressor: Presses plates. In mass mode it turns any item into mass for compressed blocks and pellets.
desc.singulo.control_unit: A restored ancient control unit with limited uses.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_casing: Wall block of the Cryogenic Cooling Tower.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_controller: Controls a 3×3 tower, 5–15 high. Taller is faster. Check the shape with the Holo Projector.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_extension: Build the tower 10+ high to liquefy helium.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_glass: Window block for the Cooling Tower.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_port: Input/output port of the Cooling Tower.
desc.singulo.copper_wire: Tier 1 power cable. Loses a little energy over distance.
desc.singulo.core_controller: Placed 5 below the core centre. Ignite the reactor from its screen.
desc.singulo.cosmic_muon_collector: Collects cosmic-ray muons for free high up under open sky.
desc.singulo.creative_catalyst: Creative only. A catalyst that never wears out. Right-click to change its tier.
desc.singulo.creative_energy_source: Creative only. Endless power pushed into every neighbour.
desc.singulo.culture_data: A record from the culture facility.
desc.singulo.data_card_observation_log: A copy of an observation log, usable in recipes.
desc.singulo.data_card_quantum_fragment: A copy of a quantum data fragment.
desc.singulo.decoded_record: Right-click to read it and add the next ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor: Crushes matter into degenerate shells and reactor parts.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_contro: Part of a hollow 3×3×3 casing box.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace: A large generator burning Lv2 blocks.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_controll: Goes in a corner pillar of the 7×7×9 furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_piston: Pistons for the cross positions of the furnace faces.
desc.singulo.degraded_anomaly_sample: A sample from the final lab.
desc.singulo.degraded_cold_atom_trap: Restore it in the Laser Cooler.
desc.singulo.degraded_control_unit: A degraded part. Restore it in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.degraded_time_crystal_seed: Restore it to grow time crystals.
desc.singulo.dormant_singularity_seed: Guarded by the Horizon Warden. Awaken it in the encapsulator.
desc.singulo.echo_resonator: Copies echo shards using a template shard.
desc.singulo.electrolyzer: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
desc.singulo.entangled_element: Always made in pairs. Used in detectors and links.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_ring: Extracts exotic matter from a fast-spinning core.
desc.singulo.event_horizon_shield: Protects a 32-block radius from explosions, griefing and hostile spawns.
desc.singulo.exotic_matter: Matter with negative energy density. Fuels gravity tech.
desc.singulo.explorer_compass: Right-click to point at the nearest ruin of the chosen kind. Sneak-use to change the kind.
desc.singulo.extraction_port: Power/fuel port for the reactor. Replaces any ring shell block (not the gyro drives).
desc.singulo.focusing_magnet: Magnet for the ring corners and at least 1/4 of the ring.
desc.singulo.gravitational_containment_t: The only tank that holds dark matter. Keeps its contents when broken.
desc.singulo.gravitational_wave_detector: Points toward the nearest gravitational anomaly.
desc.singulo.graviton_manipulator: The full gravity tool. Hold left-click to use; while levitating, charge with right-click and release to throw.
desc.singulo.gravity_field_stabilizer: A component of the core controller.
desc.singulo.gyro_drive: Placed where the reactor rings cross.
desc.singulo.halo_collector: Gathers dark matter near a running core.
desc.singulo.handbook: Right-click to open. Explains goals, machines, multiblocks and shows your progress.
desc.singulo.heat_exchange_core: Stack these in the tower core: at least height − 2.
desc.singulo.holo_projector: Use on a multiblock controller to project its shape and list missing blocks. Sneak-use to change size.
desc.singulo.horizon_bus: The tier 5 cable, needed to ignite the reactor.
desc.singulo.inertial_control_gauntlet: Hold right-click to levitate or pull one small mob. Sneak-use to switch modes.
desc.singulo.inertial_stabilizer: Stops explosions from breaking blocks within 16 blocks.
desc.singulo.jet_collector: Collects jet condensate from the reactor.
desc.singulo.kiln: Fires ceramics and boards. Oxygen makes it hotter.
desc.singulo.laser_cooler: Laser-cools atoms into cold atoms, lattices and condensates.
desc.singulo.magnetic_bottle: Captures strangelets and contains leaking strange matter.
desc.singulo.magnetic_monopole: A theoretical particle born in about 1 of 1000 collisions.
desc.singulo.mass_pellet: Packed mass fuel for the P-Reactor.
desc.singulo.metric_drive: Switch between low gravity, flight and high gravity.
desc.singulo.mirror_plate: Mirror for the top and bottom of the C-Cavity.
desc.singulo.monopole_upgrade: Insert into a machine's monopole slot: ×2 speed and 50% better power efficiency.
desc.singulo.muon_bundle: A bundle of muons, the base of muon catalysts.
desc.singulo.muon_catalyst: Tier 2 catalyst with a lifetime. Leaves a spent catalyst when used up.
desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner: Reveals ruins and ores through terrain for 10 seconds.
desc.singulo.observation_log: A record from observation posts. Copy it onto data cards.
desc.singulo.optical_lattice_substrate: Atoms held in a lattice of light.
desc.singulo.particle_accelerator: Collides particles into muon bundles and rare monopoles.
desc.singulo.penrose_reactor: Draws energy from a spinning black hole.
desc.singulo.precision_assembler: Assembles most parts and machines from tier 2 on.
desc.singulo.probe_station: Sends probes to discovered ruins to fetch loot.
desc.singulo.reactor_shell: Shell of the reactor's three rings.
desc.singulo.record_fragment: A fragment of an ancient record. Decode it in the Archive Terminal to add it to the handbook.
desc.singulo.ruin_cache: Holds ruin loot. Refills some days after emptied.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp: An ancient lamp that still glows.
desc.singulo.seal_console: Touch it to wake the Horizon Warden.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_core: Bottom centre of the 3×3×9 shield tower.
desc.singulo.singularity_seed: Becomes a black hole core when ignited.
desc.singulo.steel_blend: A mix of iron and coal. Smelt it in a blast furnace to get steel.
desc.singulo.steel_ingot: The basic structural metal. Steel from other mods works too.
desc.singulo.steel_plate: Pressed steel used for casings and parts.
desc.singulo.strange_matter: Ultra-dense matter left by strangelets. Worth 100 mass and usable for degenerate shells.
desc.singulo.strangelet: Converts nearby blocks into strange matter. Contain it with a Magnetic Bottle.
desc.singulo.superconducting_coil: A zero-resistance coil, core of tier 2 tech.
desc.singulo.thermocouple_module: Turns a temperature difference into electricity.
desc.singulo.thermoelectric_generator: Place it between something hot and something cold to generate power. Your first generator.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_catalyst: Tier 4 catalyst used by most advanced devices.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_incubator: Grows time crystal catalysts. Underpowering lowers their purity.
desc.singulo.unfired_ceramic: Clay and sand, ready to be fired into white ceramic.
desc.singulo.white_ceramic_composite: The white ceramic used for casings and circuit boards.
desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_advanced: Advanced chunk loader. Embedding a Singularity Core makes it free and maximal.
desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_small: Keeps nearby chunks loaded while fed a catalyst.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator: Creates a pair of wormhole mouths from 100 MFE/t for 10 s.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_core: Bottom centre of the 3×3×3 wormhole generator.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_io: Replaces any casing block of the Wormhole Generator. Feeds power in and lets the mouths out.
desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth: Links to its twin. Needs exotic matter upkeep.
gui.singulo.anchor.confirm_embed: Right-click again to embed the core (it can never be removed)

guide.singulo.catalysts.slots.body: Catalyst machines have a dedicated slot that accepts only catalysts. Spent catalysts can be recycled into about 25% of a lower-tier catalyst.
guide.singulo.catalysts.slots.title: Catalyst slots and recycling
guide.singulo.catalysts.tiers.body: Muon (2), BE (3), Time crystal (4), Singularity core (5). Higher tier = faster and less wear; one lower = half speed and double wear; two lower = unusable. Underpowering wears catalysts faster.
guide.singulo.catalysts.tiers.title: Tiers and effects
guide.singulo.catalysts.time.body: Near a running reactor catalysts wear at ×0.5; inside a T-Cylinder field ×2. The two cancel out.
guide.singulo.catalysts.time.title: Time fields
guide.singulo.hazards.list.body:
- Tidal zone ignores armour.
- Leaking hydrogen near fire explodes.
- Large accelerators may leak strangelets that convert blocks into strange matter; contain them with a Magnetic Bottle.
guide.singulo.hazards.list.title: Hazards
guide.singulo.intro.basics.body:
Power (FE) travels through Singulo cables; items and fluids use per-side settings and other mods' pipes.
From stage 2 you use catalysts: consumables with a lifetime, placed in a dedicated catalyst slot. One tier above the machine is faster; one below is slower and wears faster; two below cannot be used.
Ancient ruins hold records and parts you cannot craft. Start looking for Observation Posts early.
guide.singulo.intro.basics.title: Power, catalysts and ruins
guide.singulo.intro.howto.body:
- Pick a chapter on the left; flip pages with the arrows.
- The Progress chapter shows finished and next goals (same as the Singulo advancement tab).
- Hover items for a description; hold Shift for recipes and uses.
- Use the Holo Projector on a multiblock controller to see its shape.
guide.singulo.intro.howto.title: Using this book
guide.singulo.intro.welcome.body:
Singulo is a tech mod about extracting energy from mass. Start with thermoelectric power, climb through cryogenic, quantum and temporal tech, and finally run a spinning black hole.
There are five stages. Read the stage chapters in order to know what to build next.
guide.singulo.intro.welcome.title: Welcome to Singulo
guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.body: cooling_tower, particle_accelerator, degenerate_compactor, casimir_cavity, degenerate_furnace, penrose_reactor, event_horizon_shield, tipler_cylinder, wormhole_generator.
guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.title: Multiblock list
guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body:
1. Place the controller; the structure extends behind it.
2. Use the projector on it to see the shape and a material list.
3. Fill the cyan boxes, clear the red ones. It lights up when complete.
4. Sneak-use to change size.
In creative: /singulo build <name> [size].
guide.singulo.power.cables.body: Copper wire → superconducting cable → topological wire → horizon bus. A network carries what its weakest cable can.
guide.singulo.power.cables.title: Cables
guide.singulo.power.sides.body: Use the Sides button in a machine screen to set each face to off / input / output / both, with optional auto-eject.
guide.singulo.power.sides.title: Side configuration
guide.singulo.power.wormhole.body: The only wireless link. Generate, stabilize, carry and place the mouths; ports near them link machines.
guide.singulo.power.wormhole.title: Wormholes
guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.body: Collect near a core, store in containment tanks, feed the core directly.
guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.title: Dark matter
guide.singulo.romance.gear.body: Metric Drive, Graviton Manipulator, Advanced Worldline Anchor.
guide.singulo.romance.gear.title: Gravity gear
guide.singulo.romance.shield.body: Protects a 32-block radius. With a Singularity Core it also blocks hostile spawns.
guide.singulo.romance.shield.title: Event Horizon Shield
guide.singulo.romance.tipler.title: T-Cylinder
guide.singulo.ruins.list.body: Observation Post, Research Building, Culture Facility, Final Lab — each guards loot for one catalyst tier.
guide.singulo.ruins.list.title: The four ruins
guide.singulo.ruins.records.body: Ruin caches sometimes hold record fragments. Decode them in the Archive Terminal to unlock the Ancient Records chapter.
guide.singulo.ruins.records.title: Record fragments
guide.singulo.stage1.goal.body: The key is the Superconducting Coil, made in the Cryogenic Cooling Tower. It needs a Control Unit from an Observation Post. Find one, restore the unit in the Archive Terminal, then build the tower.
guide.singulo.stage1.goal.title: Reaching stage 2
guide.singulo.stage1.machines.body:
- Kiln: fires ceramic boards and steel.
- Compressor: plates, and mass mode for compressed blocks.
- Electrolyzer: water to hydrogen and oxygen.
- Archive Terminal: copies records, restores parts, decodes fragments.
guide.singulo.stage1.machines.title: Stage 1 machines
guide.singulo.stage1.materials.body:
1. Iron + coal = steel blend; smelt it in a blast furnace.
2. Clay, quartz, bone meal and sand make unfired ceramic; fire it into white ceramic.
3. Make basic circuits and basic frames. Most machines need these.
guide.singulo.stage1.materials.title: First materials
guide.singulo.stage1.power.body:
The Thermoelectric Generator produces power from a temperature difference: put something hot (lava, a lit furnace, a campfire) on one side and something cold (water, ice) on the other.
Connect machines with copper wire.
guide.singulo.stage1.power.title: First power
guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.body: Build a square ring of tubes and magnets (8–32 wide), magnets on the corners and on at least a quarter of the ring. It turns hydrogen into muon bundles (and rare monopoles). The Catalytic Reactor turns them into muon catalysts.
guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.title: Particle Accelerator and muon catalyst
guide.singulo.stage2.goal.body: You need liquid helium (tower 10+ high, helium from crushed deepslate) and quantum data from Research Buildings.
guide.singulo.stage2.goal.title: Reaching stage 3
guide.singulo.stage2.others.body:
- Precision Assembler: makes almost everything from stage 3 on.
- Cryogenic Turbine: power from evaporating nitrogen.
- SMES Cell: stores energy.
- Small Worldline Anchor: chunk loader fed by catalysts.
- Monopole Upgrade: ×2 speed, +50% efficiency in a machine's monopole slot.
guide.singulo.stage2.others.title: Other stage 2 devices
guide.singulo.stage2.tower.body: A 3×3 column, 5–15 high: casing/glass/ports around, heat exchange cores in the middle (height − 2 or more). It makes liquid nitrogen from air and superconducting coils.
guide.singulo.stage2.tower.title: Cryogenic Cooling Tower
guide.singulo.stage3.goal.body: The key is exotic matter from the C-Cavity, which needs time crystal catalysts. Search the deep Culture Facility.
guide.singulo.stage3.goal.title: Reaching stage 4
guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.body:
- Entanglement Synthesizer: entangled elements, two at a time.
- Laser Cooler: cold atoms, lattices, BE condensate catalyst.
- Quantum Heat Engine: catalyst-driven generator.
guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.title: Quantum machines
guide.singulo.stage3.tools.body:
- Inertial Control Gauntlet: levitate or pull small mobs.
- Inertial Stabilizer: explosion-proofs a 16-block radius.
- Gravitational Wave Detector: points to anomalies.
- Neutrino Scanner: shows ruins and ores through terrain.
guide.singulo.stage3.tools.title: Tools and exploration
guide.singulo.stage4.compression.body: Mass mode turns anything into compressed blocks, Lv1 to Lv3. Lv1 made from 3+ kinds of blocks is "mixed" and only 8 are needed for Lv2. The Degenerate Compactor (3×3×3 casing box) makes degenerate shells.
guide.singulo.stage4.compression.title: Compression chain
guide.singulo.stage4.goal.body: Wake and defeat the Horizon Warden at the Final Lab to get a dormant singularity seed, awaken it in the encapsulator and ignite it in the P-Reactor.
guide.singulo.stage4.goal.title: Reaching stage 5
guide.singulo.stage4.power.body:
- Degenerate Furnace (7×7×9): 20 MFE/t from Lv2 blocks.
- Probe Station: automates trips to discovered ruins.
- Topological wire and SMES modules for large power.
guide.singulo.stage4.power.title: Big power and automation
guide.singulo.stage4.time.body: The incubator grows time crystals over 20 minutes of real running time; underpowering lowers purity. The C-Cavity (5×5×5, mirror top and bottom) makes exotic matter.
guide.singulo.stage4.time.title: Time crystals and exotic matter
guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.body: Collectors produce jet condensate, H-Condensate and exotic matter. The Singularity Core is the tier 5 catalyst.
guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.title: By-products and the Singularity Core
guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.body: With cores and power you can run the late-game devices: shields, T-Cylinders and wormholes.
guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.title: Beyond
guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.body: Insert the seed, press Ignite and deliver 50 GFE within 10 s. Burn mass pellets; efficiency depends on spin. Mind the 24-block pull zone (time runs slower there) and the 4-block tidal zone.
guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.title: Ignition and operation
guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.body: Three continuous orthogonal rings of radius 6 (48 blocks each): gyro drives where they cross, twelve extraction ports at the 45° points, reactor shell elsewhere, an empty 3×3×3 core. The core controller sits 5 below the centre.
guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.title: Building the reactor

jei.singulo.mb.casimir_cavity:
■ Build: 5×5×5
■ Start: supply power, put a catalyst in its slot (recipe machine)
■ Uses: power, inputs and catalyst uses per recipe
jei.singulo.mb.cooling_tower:
■ Build: 3×3 tower, 5-15 tall. Parts shown for height 5
■ Start: just supply power (recipe machine)
■ Speed: height ÷ 5 (×3 at 15)
■ Height ≥10: unlocks liquid helium recipes
■ Uses: power and inputs per recipe
jei.singulo.mb.degenerate_compactor:
■ Build: 3×3×3
■ Start: just supply power (recipe machine)
■ Uses: power and inputs per recipe (see controller recipes)
jei.singulo.mb.degenerate_furnace:
■ Build: 7×7 furnace, 9 tall
■ Start: time crystal in the catalyst slot, then add fuel
■ Fuel: compressed block Lv2 (1 per 10 s)
■ Output: 20 MFE/t × catalyst speed
jei.singulo.mb.event_horizon_shield:
■ Build: 3×3 tower, 9 tall
■ Start: time crystal or singularity core in the catalyst slot, plus power
■ Uses: 16,384 FE/t (∝ radius²)
■ Effect: protects and boosts machines within radius 32
jei.singulo.mb.particle_accelerator:
■ Build: square ring, side 8-32. Parts shown for side 8
■ Start: just supply power (recipe machine)
■ Speed: side ÷ 8
■ Byproduct: monopole 0.1% × side/32
■ Hazard: side ≥24 with buffer <20% may spawn a strangelet
jei.singulo.mb.penrose_reactor:
■ Build: 13×13×13 continuous rings (3 planes) + shells
■ Ignite: insert a seed singularity, then 50 GFE within 10 s (horizon bus needed)
■ Fuel: mass pellets
■ Efficiency: 5.7-42.3% by spin
■ Limit: Eddington — 1 pellet/s per 1000 core mass
■ Max output: about 2.1 GFE/t
■ Byproducts: from the collectors at the ports
■ Extraction ports: replace any ring shell block, as many as you like (power in/out, fuel, byproducts)
jei.singulo.mb.tipler_cylinder:
■ Build: 3×3 column, 7 tall
■ Start: time crystal in the catalyst slot, fuel and power
■ Fuel: exotic matter (1 per minute)
■ Uses: 100 kFE/t
■ Effect: machines within radius 8 run ×2
jei.singulo.mb.wormhole_generator:
■ Build: 3×3×3
■ Start: feed 100 MFE/t for 10 s (topological cable is enough; config wormholeGeneratorPower)
■ Result: a linked pair of wormhole mouths
■ I/O ports: replace any casing block (power in, mouths out)

message.singulo.records_complete: You have read every ancient record
message.singulo.welcome: You received the Singulo Handbook. Right-click to open it
record.singulo.r01.body: Surface observation begins today. Our goal is simple: turn mass into energy, all of it. Stone, wood, the sea — all of it is frozen energy.
record.singulo.r01.title: Observation Log 1
record.singulo.r02.body: Thermoelectric efficiency is below 0.0001%. Burning fuel for a gradient is like moving a mountain to pick up a grain of sand. Still, this is where we must begin.
record.singulo.r02.title: Observation Log 7
record.singulo.r03.body: All casings shall be white, so that every stain shows. Anomalies must be found while they are still visible.
record.singulo.r03.title: Note from the Chief Designer
record.singulo.r04.body: Unmanned guards are stationed at every post. They do not tell intruders from staff. Anyone who carries records out is an intruder.
record.singulo.r04.title: Security Regulation
record.singulo.r05.body: At zero resistance a current flows forever. We have obtained eternity — but only at 77 kelvin.
record.singulo.r05.title: Cryogenic Programme
record.singulo.r06.body: One collision in a thousand yields a magnet with only a north pole. The theorists were delighted. The engineers, finding it doubled a machine's speed, were more delighted still.
record.singulo.r06.title: Accelerator Logbook
record.singulo.r07.body: Someone argued catalysts should never wear out. Rejected: it is because they wear out that we reach for the next tier.
record.singulo.r07.title: On Catalysts
record.singulo.r08.body: When an anchor stops, time stops in its region. Those inside never notice. Not noticing was deemed not to be a problem.
record.singulo.r08.title: Ethics of Worldline Anchoring
record.singulo.r09.body: Entangled elements are always born in pairs. Break one and the other loses its meaning. Will our cities be the same?
record.singulo.r09.title: Quantum Division Report
record.singulo.r10.body: In a Bose condensate every atom becomes one wave. One researcher called it a choir. She left the division that week.
record.singulo.r10.title: A Dream of Condensates
record.singulo.r11.body: Something far away shook spacetime. We know the direction and the distance band. What we do not know is whether it was natural.
record.singulo.r11.title: First Gravitational Wave
record.singulo.r12.body: The research building is closed. No reason will be published. The lock codes have been replaced with redstone signals.
record.singulo.r12.title: Research Building Closure
record.singulo.r13.body: A time crystal ticks forever without spending energy. At last we can grow clocks themselves.
record.singulo.r13.title: Time Crystals
record.singulo.r14.body: Put two mirrors around nothing and you get less than nothing. Negative energy. We turned it into matter.
record.singulo.r14.title: C-Cavity Notes
record.singulo.r15.body: Cryogenic control failed. Some seeds slipped out of the flow of time. The section is sealed. Staff remain inside.
record.singulo.r15.title: Culture Facility Final Report
record.singulo.r16.body: A teaspoon of neutron-star matter weighs as much as a mountain. We cut it into blocks and stacked it neatly.
record.singulo.r16.title: A Poem on Degeneracy
record.singulo.r17.body: Energy will be drawn from the ergosphere of a spinning black hole. Theoretical efficiency: 42%. At last, all mass can become energy. The project is approved.
record.singulo.r17.title: Penrose Project Approved
record.singulo.r18.body: Tomorrow we ignite the seed. The horizon warden is in place. Should the core escape, the procedure is to seal the entire facility.
record.singulo.r18.title: The Night Before Ignition
record.singulo.r19.body: ...ignition successful. Output is... no, the spin will not stop... past the Eddington limit... stop the feed...
record.singulo.r19.title: Ignition Record (fragment)
record.singulo.r20.body: We wanted to turn all mass into energy. The reactor granted that wish — the cities, the mountains, the sea. All that remains is the anomaly, the warden and this record. To whoever reads this: never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
record.singulo.r20.title: The Last Record
